ai_insights_pune.observation: Trainees placed outside their home cluster with daily commutes exceeding 25 km exhibit a 31% higher 90-day attrition rate.
ai_insights_pune.possible_explanation: Entry salaries of ₹18,000–₹20,000 in major urban industrial nodes create living cost pressures during the initial 90-day probationary period.
ai_insights_pune.suggested_action: Provide a ₹2,000/mo 3-month transition stipend and mandate employer transit bus facilitation for industrial cluster placements.
